scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const dir='tests';const hasTests=fs.existsSync(dir)&&fs.readdirSync(dir).some((file)=>file.endsWith('.test.js'));if(!hasTests){console.log('No test files found; skipping node --test');process.exit(0);}const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test',dir],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(result.status);"
scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const files=['app.js','pages/index/index.js','utils/timer.js','utils/playbackState.js','services/soundSourceService.js'].filter((file)=>fs.existsSync(file));for(const file of files){const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',file],{stdio:'inherit'});if(result.status){process.exit(result.status);}}console.log('checked '+files.length+' file(s)');"
